dialogues.speaker: Anand
dialogues.text: It's part of what I do.

dialogues.speaker: Anand
dialogues.text: The only concern I have is manpower shortage.

dialogues.speaker: Anand
dialogues.text: The competition between caravans has caused many artisans like us to change line of work.

dialogues.speaker: Anand
dialogues.text: But I won't leave, for my lover is a seafarer, so I understand how important ship safety is.

dialogues.speaker: Anand
dialogues.text: I heard there's an agency called the Communications Office in Liyue that specializes in overseas shipping logistics.

dialogues.speaker: Anand
dialogues.text: Don't you think that would solve the problem of cutthroat competition?
